_about: The Reaper Collection Rebuilt perks (BO3 workshop mod 3814067303 by Logical Reaper), catalogued for Melon Zombies. Their effects work (mods/perks-plus/reaper-perks.js reads this file) but they are switched off: nothing sells them, only the cheat console gives them (`reaper <id|all>`, `reaper up <id|all>`). effect/upgrade: the mod author's "All Perks" sheet. origin: the game the perk first appeared in, where known (custom = the mod or another modder). source: the BO3/mod asset names .tools/build_reaper_perks.py builds from into mods/perks-plus/reaper/ (git-ignored). new: false = Melon Zombies already has the perk (listed for its machine and jingle). Write-up: docs/fork/reaper-perks.md.

banana.name: Banana Colada
banana.effect: Sliding leaves a yellow trail that zombies slip and die on

bandolier.name: Bandolier Bandit
bandolier.upgrade: Stowed weapons slowly refill their clips

blazephase.name: Blaze Phase
blazephase.effect: Crouching charges up fire; standing releases it and flings you forward, igniting zombies
blazephase.upgrade: Charges further and explodes when stopped

bloodbullets.name: Blood Bullets
bloodbullets.effect: Ammo in the active gun slowly regenerates (clip size sets the rate); not wonder weapons except the Ray Gun
bloodbullets.upgrade: Occasionally affects stowed weapons and wonder weapons

bloodwolf.name: Blood Wolf Bite
bloodwolf.effect: Dealing a lot of damage quickly spawns a friendly wolf that hunts zombies
bloodwolf.upgrade: The wolf's kills drop mini power-ups (points, ammo, specialist power); shorter recharge

bull_ice.name: Bull Ice Blast
bull_ice.effect: Double jump, then crouch in the air to slam down and blast zombies into ice

changechews.name: Change Chews
changechews.effect: Headshots can trigger one of 4 elemental explosions; the element changes at low health
changechews.upgrade: Effects are stronger and last longer

crusade.name: Crusader's Ale
crusade.effect: Double melee points, more knife damage, the shield repairs itself between rounds
crusade.upgrade: Kills can slightly heal the shield

damnade.name: Dam-A-Nade
damnade.effect: Stronger explosives, one more lethal and tactical; at round end all lethals and 1 tactical refill

downers.name: Downer's Delight
downers.effect: Double bleed-out time; keep your primary weapon when downed

dyingwish.name: Dying Wish
dyingwish.effect: Negates death for 9 s on 1 health (5 min cooldown); melee kills basic zombies outright meanwhile

estatic.name: Estatic Elixir
estatic.effect: Sprinting builds an electric charge that stuns nearby zombies
estatic.upgrade: Every 10 stuns stores a charge (max 4); when hit, a charge stuns nearby zombies

razor.name: Ethereal Razor
razor.effect: Melee hits several zombies, deals much more damage and heals

ffyl.name: Fighter's Fizz
ffyl.effect: Keep your gun when downed; get a kill to revive yourself and keep all perks
ffyl.upgrade: Keep Fighter's Fizz when reviving (losing the upgrade)

icu.name: I.C.U.
icu.effect: Faster health regen, speed boost at low health, invincible while doing actions
icu.upgrade: Invincibility and speed boost last longer

inferno.name: Inciner-Brandy
inferno.effect: Chance to ignite zombies (damage over time); zombies killed by fire can explode

moonshine.name: Madgaz Moonshine
moonshine.effect: Sliding makes an explosion (20 a round); shot zombies can catch fire

magnet.name: Magnet Margarita
magnet.effect: Power-ups drift toward the nearest player with this perk, stopping short of them
magnet.upgrade: Power-ups move twice as fast; your kills can spawn bonus power-ups

mh_mocha.name: Miracle Hands Mocha
mh_mocha.effect: Faster equipment use; change a power-up up to 3 times
mh_mocha.upgrade: No Carpenter or Nuke results, one more change, Max Ammo becomes a free perk bottle

momentum.name: Momentum Mojito
momentum.effect: Sprinting builds speed; at top speed, charged sprints damage zombies you pass (10 charges, refilled by kills; double-tap sprint toggles kill mode)
momentum.upgrade: 15 charges, momentum starts faster with more charges, not lost when sliding

milk.name: Muscle Milk
milk.effect: Melee stabs chain electricity between zombies (15 s cooldown)

nitrogen.name: Nitrogen Cooled
nitrogen.effect: Nearby zombies slow to a walk

nobear.name: No Bear Brew
nobear.effect: No teddy bears from the Mystery Box
nobear.upgrade: Move the box once a round; it sometimes spins free nearby

nukacola.name: Nuka Cola
nukacola.effect: Going down sets off a Nuke
nukacola.upgrade: Picking up a power-up can spawn another (always with Nukes)

phdslider.name: PhD Flopper (Cold War)
phdslider.effect: Sliding into zombies explodes; immune to explosive damage
phdslider.upgrade: More damage from higher drops and longer slides

packbox.name: Pack-A-Box
packbox.effect: Chance of a Pack-a-Punched weapon from the Mystery Box

pointcrusher.name: Point Crusher
pointcrusher.effect: Can earn extra points per kill
pointcrusher.upgrade: Chance to double the extra points

repairman.name: Repairman Rum
repairman.effect: Instant window repairs, double repair points; boards you repaired explode when torn off
repairman.upgrade: 4x repair point cap; Carpenter gets every effect and double points

spectorshot.name: Spectre Shot
spectorshot.effect: Switching weapons near 10+ zombies summons a spectral copy of the last gun that auto-fires; hits slow, kills refill that gun
spectorshot.upgrade: Spectral hits deal bonus damage and go for heads; longer, faster cooldown

stronghold.name: Stone Cold Stronghold
stronghold.effect: Standing still forms a ring that builds armour over time
stronghold.upgrade: Armour builds faster and lingers after leaving the ring

swarmscotch.name: Swarm Scotch
swarmscotch.effect: Some headshots and empty-clip reloads release a friendly insect swarm that damages zombies
swarmscotch.upgrade: Swarm survivors spawn swarms more often; more swarm damage

tactiquilla.name: Tactiquilla Sangria
tactiquilla.effect: Fire while sprinting, chance to regain fired ammo, multi-kills give bonus points
tactiquilla.upgrade: Higher ammo chance, doubled multi-kill rewards

timeslip.name: Timeslip
timeslip.effect: Faster Mystery Box spins and Pack-a-Punch
timeslip.upgrade: Faster special-weapon recharge, instant box spins

tombstone.name: Tombstone
tombstone.effect: Solo: when downed, sacrifice all but one random gun to revive. Co-op: bleeding out leaves a stash of perks and weapons for 1 minute after respawn
tombstone.upgrade: Co-op: the stash doesn't start fading until the round after respawn

victorious.name: Victorious Tortoise
victorious.effect: A held shield blocks damage from every direction and explodes when destroyed

vigor.name: Vigor Rush
vigor.effect: Bullet hits on zombies make small explosions

winterwail.name: Winter's Wail
winterwail.effect: Getting hurt slows and freezes nearby zombies (3 uses)
winterwail.upgrade: One more charge; the effect lingers

zombshell.name: Zombshell
zombshell.effect: Shooting a zombie can create a slowing field that also weakens zombies
zombshell.upgrade: Zombies ignore you while you stand in the field

bubbleblink.name: Bubble Blink Blast
bubbleblink.effect: Melee the air while sprinting to teleport forward, leaving a decoy afterimage; kills recharge

guardianangel.name: Guardian Angel Ale
guardianangel.effect: Taking damage grants 5 s of invincibility; kills recharge
guardianangel.upgrade: Hits while recharging grant 0.6 s of invincibility

pointpolosa.name: Point Polosa
pointpolosa.effect: Rarely, killed zombies become point fountains
pointpolosa.upgrade: Zombies can drop 10 s mini Double Points

prismatic.name: Prismatic Punch
prismatic.effect: Kills raise an energy wall that ricochets bullets toward zombies; shooting it grows it (extra ricochet at max)
prismatic.upgrade: Bigger wall, longer at max, more stray ricochets

whoswho.name: Who's Who
whoswho.effect: Going down spawns a clone you control with the gun you held; reviving your body restores your perks
whoswho.upgrade: Your downed body keeps shooting; the clone has all your weapons
